items.quote: And when the children of Israel saw it
items.claim: The children of Israel observed a substance

items.quote: they said one to another, It is manna
items.claim: The children of Israel identified the substance as manna

items.quote: for they wist not what it was
items.claim: The children of Israel did not know what the substance actually was

items.quote: And Moses said unto them, This is the bread which the LORD hath given you to eat
items.claim: Moses told them the substance was bread provided by the LORD

items.quote: the bread which the LORD hath given you to eat
items.claim: The LORD gave bread to the children of Israel
